The concatenation of multi-column data into single text strings in Tables 7 and 8 destroys the technical utility of the report, necessitating human intervention to restore data integrity.

concerns.analysis: Several technical tables are severely misrendered. In Table 7 (Baseline Stream Data Summary) and Table 8 (Cross-Section Morphology Data Summary), the multi-column numeric data has been concatenated into a single string within a single table cell for each row. This destroys the tabular structure and makes the data impossible to read or interpret correctly. For example, row 1 of Table 7 in the HTML contains 16 distinct values run together in one <td> element.
